name: Corruption Time
source:
Strange events begin to occur in the life of Bob since dreaming of a mysterious girl, how will this affect his life with his family? Welcome to the world of Corruption Time which is not intending to win any awards for originality but does hope to make up for it with an original art style and self proclaimed witty 'humour'!

[FromF95Zone]
translation:
自从梦见一个神秘女孩后，鲍勃的生活中就开始发生怪事。这会如何影响他与家人的生活？欢迎来到《Corruption Time》的世界。本作无意凭独创性赢得什么奖项，只希望以独特的画风，以及自称机智的“幽默”来弥补！

[摘自F95Zone]
